description.zh: 云电脑启动时设置的默认语言，仅在使用系统镜像创建云电脑的场景下生效。
description.en: The default language to set when the WUYING Workspace starts. This parameter is valid only when you create a WUYING Workspace from an OS image.

description.zh:
模板的描述。必须符合以下要求：

- 长度2~256个字符，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。
- 支持中文、英文、数字、空格和特殊符号，使用回车换行。
description.en:
The description of the template. The description must meet the following requirements:

- It must be 2 to 256 characters in length. It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

- It can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, spaces, and special characters. Use line breaks to start a new line.

description.zh: 云电脑镜像ID，可以从镜像管理页面查询，支持系统镜像、自定义镜像等类型。
description.en: The ID of the WUYING Workspace image. You can find the ID on the Image Management page. OS images and custom images are supported.
The ID of the global policy.

description.zh:
地域化的模板信息配置， 支持配置多个。 使用时会根据具体的地域匹配。

> 最多支持20个地域的配置。
description.en:
The region-specific template configurations. You can specify configurations for multiple regions. The system matches the configuration based on the specific region.

> You can specify configurations for up to 20 regions.
The ID of the resource group.

description.zh: 云电脑标签。Key-Value格式。最多可传入20个标签。
description.en: Tags for the cloud computer, in key-value format. You can specify up to 20 tags.

description.zh:
系统盘类型。

> 只有高主频和图形型的云电脑规格支持ESSD类型的磁盘。
description.en:
The type of the system disk.

> Enhanced SSD (ESSD) disks are supported only by cloud computers with high clock speeds and powerful graphics capabilities.

description.zh:
系统盘大小。单位：GiB。取值范围: 40~500，每10GiB为一个步长。

> 系统盘大小不能小于配置的镜像大小。
description.en:
The size of the system disk. Unit: GiB. The value must be between 40 and 500, inclusive. The step size is 10 GiB.

> The system disk size cannot be smaller than the size of the image.

description.zh:
模板的名称。必须符合以下要求：

- 长度2~126个英文或中文字符。
- 必须以大小写字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。
- 可以包含字母、数字、汉字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或短划线（-），不支持点号（.）。
description.en:
The name of the template. The name must meet the following requirements:

- It must be 2 to 126 characters in length.

- It must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

- It can contain letters, digits, Chinese characters, colons (:), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-). It cannot contain periods (.).
The ID of the configuration group.

title.zh: 修改自定义云电脑模板全部参数

descriptions.zh: ><warning>为了兼容模板中参数的不设置与默认升级逻辑，该接口采用全量参数更新逻辑，换言之，不设置的参数均视为设置为空。></warning>
descriptions.en:
><warning>

This operation updates all parameters. To ensure compatibility with the default upgrade logic, any parameter that you do not specify is set to empty.

></warning>
